mechanisms.name: sentinel octet stuffing
mechanisms.contract: Encode each source octet as two lower-case hexadecimal digits, except sentinel 202 becomes the two-octet escape 203,234. Concatenate encoded octets without separators.

mechanisms.name: run-length expansion
mechanisms.contract: Expand each glyph by its specified repeat count and concatenate in the listed order. No glyph may be dropped or added.

mechanisms.name: bitwise XOR whitening
mechanisms.contract: The emitted octet is the bitwise exclusive-or of the source octet and the whitening mask. No arithmetic addition is used.

mechanisms.name: cyclic alphabet substitution
mechanisms.contract: Shift each uppercase Latin letter forward by the configured displacement in the cyclic alphabet A through Z, retaining letter order. Displacements from zero through twenty-five are allowed.

mechanisms.name: literal codeword concatenation
mechanisms.contract: Replace each source symbol with its stated codeword, then concatenate codewords in source order. Codewords are literal strings, not component or entity identifiers.

mechanisms.name: matrix axis transposition
mechanisms.contract: The emitted matrix is the transpose of the supplied two-by-two source matrix: output row r, column c equals source row c, column r, with zero-based indices.

mechanisms.name: LIFO stack removal
mechanisms.contract: The list is ordered bottom to top. Remove exactly the final item and emit the remaining list in its original order. All lists in scope are nonempty.

mechanisms.name: signed zigzag integer coding
mechanisms.contract: Encode a nonnegative signed integer n as 2*n; encode a negative n as -2*n-1. Emit the exact unsigned integer, without truncation.

mechanisms.name: lexicographic key canonicalization
mechanisms.contract: Emit the supplied distinct lowercase ASCII keys in ascending lexicographic order, without changing, adding or dropping a key.

mechanisms.name: Euclidean quotient and residue
mechanisms.contract: For nonnegative dividend n and positive divisor d, emit the unique integer quotient q and residue r such that n=q*d+r and 0<=r<d.
